verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly list documented integrations with LangGraph, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, Google ADK, AutoGen, LiveKit, and others, framed as a dedicated 'memory for agent frameworks' feature that persists conversation turns and retrieves Context Graph data. LangChain is not explicitly named in the framework list, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of these integrations working in practice.
